article.title: 'Everyone saw it' - Iraola confused by Isak penalty decision
article.summary: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola reacts to his side's defeat at home to league leaders Arsenal, saying he "doesn't understand" why Alexander Isak was not awarded a penalty.
